title: Corytus
summary: Raleigh names Corytus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Corytus, or Coritus, King to whom Electra was giuen, and father of Chryse and, in Annius, of Dardanus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIV, §. I, sig. 277b–278a
